subject.title: [Feature]: Plugin API for aborting agent runs (api.runtime.agent.abort)

question: Should OpenClaw expose a plugin runtime method that can abort agent runs by runId, and what ownership/session permission model must it enforce?
rationale: Source inspection confirms the API gap, but adding this method changes what plugin code can terminate and would create a public PluginRuntime contract.

options.title: Design a scoped runtime abort API
options.body: Approve a narrow `api.runtime.agent.abort` shape only after defining plugin identity, session/run ownership, and tests that prove unrelated runs cannot be cancelled.

options.title: Use existing Gateway/session cancellation surfaces
options.body: Decline a new plugin runtime method for now and document `sessions.abort`, `chat.abort`, or a maintainer-approved session-run-cancel seam as the supported boundary.

options.title: Defer until broader cancel API direction settles
options.body: Keep this issue open but blocked on the broader cancellation-authority discussion represented by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/75371 and related abort issues.

recommendation.title: Design a scoped runtime abort API
recommendation.body: Approve a narrow `api.runtime.agent.abort` shape only after defining plugin identity, session/run ownership, and tests that prove unrelated runs cannot be cancelled.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice is primarily a public Plugin SDK/runtime boundary and security-authority decision, and steipete has recent adjacent Plugin SDK/runtime history.
